globalAlerts.warning: BUILD FIRST: Always run `make build` before running scripts. The osm binary must be up-to-date.
TEST AFTER EVERY CHANGE: Run `go test -short -count=1 -timeout=5m ./...` after each significant change to catch regressions early.
ZERO TOLERANCE: Tests must be isolated -- no host state mutation, no external dependencies, no flaky timing-dependent tests.
PLATFORM COMPATIBILITY: All code must work identically on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
JAVASCRIPT SCRIPTS: All app-specific functionality MUST be modeled as JavaScript scripts using the osm runtime.
PTY TESTS: All PTY tests use termtest.NewConsole and must respect unix build tag. Slow tests must use testing.Short() skip guards.
RULE OF TWO: Every commit must pass two contiguous issue-free subagent reviews before being committed.
ADVERSARIAL AUTOPSY SOURCE: ./scratch/impl-gaps-pull-out-hackery-proper-ecosystem/ contains the full adversarial analysis with file paths and line numbers.
WAVE 4 AUTOPSY SOURCE: ./scratch/termmux-functional-autopsy-20260615/ and ./scratch/builtin-termmux-autopsy-20260615/ contain the adversarial audits that generated tasks 69-98.
DEPENDENCY ORDER IS MANDATORY: Tasks are sequenced so that later tasks depend on earlier ones. Do not reorder without updating this blueprint and logging the deviation.
DECSC/DECRC SPEC NOTE: Per xterm specification, CursorVisible and MouseTracking/MouseSGR are NOT part of the DECSC/DECRC save/restore set. These modes are intentionally excluded.
GO AS REUSABLE MODULES: Go code must be exposed as reusable, modular implementations accessible via osm script. Never hardcode application-specific logic.
JS FOR APP-SPECIFIC LOGIC: All application-specific functionality MUST be modeled as JavaScript. Don't do anything in Go that someone else couldn't do using OSM.
THIN SHIM PRINCIPLE: JS scripts should be thin configuration shims that wire up Go utilities -- like socat wiring up core utilities, not like a monolithic application.

sequentialTasks.task: Fix RespawnSession to preserve the original CaptureConfig and rebind the pane
sequentialTasks.description: `handleRespawnSession` in `internal/termmux/manager.go:2209-2283` creates `NewCaptureSession(CaptureConfig{})`, discarding the original command, args, directory, and environment. Store the original `CaptureConfig` on `managedSession` at registration time. In the respawn handler, create the new `CaptureSession` from that stored config, reattach the pane binding in whichever `paneManager` owns the pane so it references the new `SessionID`, and emit `EventSessionRegistered`/`EventSessionActivated` so front-ends update. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go (respawnSession binding), internal/termmux/pane_manager.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: A respawned session runs the same command/args/dir/env as the original. The original pane reports the new `SessionID`. `respawnSession(sid)` JS integration test succeeds. At least 5 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Gate locked-session input and render a lock overlay
sequentialTasks.description: `handleInput` in `internal/termmux/manager.go:1787-1815` forwards keystrokes to the child PTY without checking `ms.lock.IsLocked()`. Change it so a locked session consumes all keystrokes for an unlock prompt (alphanumeric/digit accumulates, Backspace deletes, Enter submits). Correct password unlocks the session and resumes normal routing; incorrect password stays locked. Expose the lock state in `Snapshot` and render a lock overlay in `Passthrough` so the screen is not visible. Add JS binding tests for lock/unlock. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/termmux/passthrough.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: No input reaches a locked child PTY. Correct password unlocks; wrong password remains locked. A lock overlay/password prompt is visible while locked. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Couple window switching with active pane focus and input routing
sequentialTasks.description: `SessionManager.ActivePaneID`, `FocusNextPane`, `FocusAt`, `ResizePaneAt`, and `Panes` currently operate on `m.paneMgr` regardless of which window is active. Track an active `WindowID` in `SessionManager`; when a window is active, route pane-level operations through that window's `paneManager`. `NextWindow`/`PrevWindow` must update `m.activeID` to a session inside the new window, focus its first pane, and emit `EventSessionActivated`. Update `WindowPanes` and `ActiveWindowID` JS bindings. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/termmux/window.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: After switching windows, `ActivePaneID()` returns a pane inside the new window, keyboard input routes to that pane, and `Panes()` returns the new window's panes. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Build a Go-side choose-tree BubbleTea overlay model
sequentialTasks.description: `Chooser` is only a list model plus `Render` string; there is no built-in overlay. Add Go-side BubbleTea model `chooseTreeModel` that wraps a `Chooser`, renders it as a centered popup, handles Up/Down/Enter/Escape, and returns the selected session/window ID. Expose `termmux.chooseTree({manager, onSelect})` returning a model object that can be passed to `tea.run`. Move the chooser binding into its own file `internal/builtin/termmux/chooser.go`. Files: internal/builtin/termmux/chooser.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/mux_state.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `chooseTree` returns a ready BubbleTea model. Arrow keys navigate, Enter selects, Escape cancels. Selection callback receives the chosen session/window ID. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add StatusBar configurable colors and top/bottom position
sequentialTasks.description: `StatusBar` in `internal/termmux/statusbar/statusbar.go` now supports `SetColors(fg, bg string)`, `SetPosition(Position)`, and a `RenderLine(width, left, right)` helper. Default rendering remains reverse-video on the bottom row. The JS `registerStatusMethods` surface exposes `setStatusColors({ fg?, bg? })`, `setStatusPosition("top"|"bottom")` (returning the module object for chaining), and a `renderStatusBar(width, left?, right?)` test/render helper. Added Go tests in `internal/termmux/statusbar/statusbar_test.go` and JS integration tests in `internal/builtin/termmux/module_status_test.go`. Files: internal/termmux/statusbar/statusbar.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go, internal/termmux/statusbar/statusbar_test.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module_status_test.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Status bar renders with configured fg/bg colors. Top position targets row 1; bottom targets the last row. Invalid hex falls back to reverse video. JS binding validates arguments and chains. At least 6 Go tests and 6 JS integration tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Render display-message overlays in passthrough and snapshots
sequentialTasks.description: Implemented a bounded FIFO display-message queue per session (cap 32) in `internal/termmux/manager.go`. Replaced the single atomic `displayMessage` pointer with `managedSession.messageQueue` and updated `handleDisplayMessage` to enqueue by call order with expiry based on duration (default 3s), dropping oldest on overflow. Added `handleActiveMessageForSession` to advance past expired front messages and return the active text. Added `Message` to `ScreenSnapshot` and `ScreenSnapshot.Clone`; snapshots now reflect the active message immediately on `DisplayMessage` and on every VTerm output publish. Implemented `MessageBarLine`/`RenderMessageBar` in new `internal/termmux/message_overlay.go` using lipgloss (yellow on dark). Updated `Passthrough` to reserve a second chrome row when an active message is present, draw the message bar above the status bar, and resize VTerm/scroll region accordingly; restored and resized paths also re-render chrome. Added `StatusBar.Height()`, `Position()`, and `SetScrollRegionEx(chromeRows)`. Exposed module-level `renderMessageBar(text, row?, cols?)` and `snapshot().message` in `internal/builtin/termmux/module.go`. Added Go tests in `internal/termmux/manager_message_test.go` and `internal/termmux/passthrough_message_test.go`. Added JS integration tests in `internal/builtin/termmux/module_message_test.go`.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `displayMessage` text appears in `Passthrough` output while active. `Snapshot` includes a `message` field that updates immediately and empties after expiry. Multiple messages queue and display sequentially in FIFO order. Bounded at 32; oldest dropped on overflow. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Implement Go-side prefix-key command dispatcher
sequentialTasks.description: Added `PrefixResult` and `PrefixDispatcher` in `internal/termmux/prefix_keys.go`. `PrefixDispatcher` maps every bound prefix key (`c`, `n`, `p`, `,`, `x`, `%`, `"`, `[`, `z`, `?`) to the corresponding `SessionManager` operation. New windows are created with a default placeholder session and activated; splits use new `SplitPaneHorizontal`/`SplitPaneVertical` methods backed by a `reqSplitPane` worker request that focuses the active pane then creates the new pane. Window focus synchronization was tightened: `handleActivate` now also updates the `WindowManager` active window via `setActive`, and `newPrefixKeyHandler` keeps its original prefix-only behavior. Added `termmux.handlePrefixKey({ manager, key })` in `internal/builtin/termmux/module.go` returning `{ action, consumed, description, result, listKeys }`.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Prefix + `c` creates a window and activates it, `n`/`p` cycle the active window, `,` renames the active window to `renamed`, `x` closes the active pane, `%`/`"` split the active pane horizontally/vertically, `[` enters copy mode, `z` zooms the active pane, `?` returns a printable key list, and unbound keys are not consumed. JS `handlePrefixKey` executes the same actions and returns the expected shape. All tests pass with race detector and lint.

sequentialTasks.task: Fix BreakPane/JoinPane session-to-pane mapping and focus consistency
sequentialTasks.description: `transferPaneToWindow` in `internal/termmux/pane_manager.go:318-363` copies the `PaneBinding` but leaves `SessionManager.activeID` and pane metadata stale. After a break or join, update source and target `paneManager` active panes when the moved pane was active, recompute geometry, and update the binding so the session can be reached by pane ID. Add JS integration tests covering break, join, and window activation. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: After `BreakPane`, the source window focuses a remaining pane and the moved pane is reachable in the new window. After `JoinPane`, the target window can focus the moved pane. `WindowPanes` reflects new mappings. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Scope synchronize-panes to the active window
sequentialTasks.description: Scoped `handleInput` in `internal/termmux/manager.go` to the active window's pane manager: it now iterates panes returned by `AllSessionIDs()` on `m.activePaneManager()` instead of every registered session. Synchronization state was already stored on `paneManager`; exposed it per-window via `Window.SetSynchronize`/`Synchronize` and `WindowManager.Active()`. Updated `SessionManager.SetSynchronizePanes` to return an error and operate on the active window (root fallback when no window is active) and `SynchronizePanes` to query the active window. Updated JS bindings in `internal/builtin/termmux/module.go` so `setSynchronizePanes(enabled)` returns the manager wrapper for chaining and `synchronizePanes()` returns the active window's sync state. Updated existing tests in `internal/termmux/manager_test.go` to create panes instead of bare sessions so broadcast semantics apply to panes. Added `internal/termmux/manager_sync_test.go` covering default-off, active-window broadcast, window-switch retargeting, disable-returns-to-single-pane, independent per-window state, and the `WindowManager.Active()`/`Window` sync accessors. Added `internal/builtin/termmux/module_sync_test.go` covering the JS bindings.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: With synchronize enabled, input reaches only panes in the active window. Switching windows switches which panes receive synchronized input. JS setters chain correctly. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Wire copy-mode search to a default Go-side screen searcher
sequentialTasks.description: `newCopyModeSearcher` in `internal/builtin/termmux/module.go:1439-1466` requires a JS `searchFn` callback. Implement a Go-side `ScreenSearcher` over `ScreenSnapshot.GetPlainText()` and use it as the default when no callback is supplied. Add convenience JS bindings `termmux.searchForward(sessionID, pattern)` and `termmux.searchBackward(sessionID, pattern)` that operate on the current snapshot. Files: internal/builtin/termmux/module.go, internal/builtin/termmux/searcher.go (new), internal/termmux/copy_mode_keys.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `newCopyModeSearcher` without a callback searches the current snapshot. `searchForward(sid, 'pattern')` returns match row/col. Copy-mode `/` works without JS wiring. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add Go-side mouse drag state machine for pane border resize
sequentialTasks.description: Mouse drag-to-resize is currently implemented only as single-shot helpers; JS must track the drag lifecycle. Add `MouseDrag` helper in `internal/termmux` that tracks button-down on a divider, motion, and release, calling `ResizePaneAt` during motion. Expose `termmux.handleMouseDrag(mgr, msg)` that consumes BubbleTea mouse messages and returns `{handled, cmd}`. Integrate it into `newBouncePresenter` and add tests. Files: internal/termmux/mouse_drag.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/mouse.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/bounce_presenter.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Dragging a divider resizes adjacent panes. A drag that does not start on a divider is ignored. Release ends the drag; events consumed during drag are not forwarded to the child. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Swap pane metadata in paneManager during LayoutEngine.Swap
sequentialTasks.description: Added `paneManager.Swap(id1, id2)` that swaps every mutable `PaneBinding` field (SessionID, VTerm, Title, LastActive, Exited, RemainOnExit) while preserving pane IDs and the active pane. Wired it into `LayoutEngine.Swap` via an optional back-pointer so direct callers update metadata, and added `swapLayoutOnly` to avoid double-swapping from `SessionManager.SwapPanes`. Updated `SessionManager.handleSwapPanes` to locate each pane's window, call the appropriate pane manager swap, keep `m.activeID` consistent, and emit `EventWindowUpdated` for affected windows. Cross-window swaps exchange metadata between the two windows while leaving pane IDs and geometries in place. Updated the JS `swapPanes` binding to return `{ swapped: true }` and propagate errors. Files: internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/layout.go, internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go, internal/termmux/pane_manager_swap_test.go, internal/termmux/manager_swap_test.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module_swap_test.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: After `SwapPanes(id1, id2)`, titles, session IDs, VTerm references, remain-on-exit, and exited states are exchanged while pane IDs remain stable. Active pane ID is unchanged; active session follows the session now in the active pane. `WindowPanes` reflects the swap for same- and cross-window cases. JS `swapPanes` returns `{ swapped: true }`. At least 8 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Implement pipe-pane to an external command

Expose via JS as `pipeCommand(sessionID, cmd, args)`. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Pane output appears in the external command's stdin. The command is terminated when the pane exits or pipe is cleared. File-only mode still works. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Refactor termmux event bridge to goja-eventloop EventTarget
sequentialTasks.description: Replaced hand-rolled `muxEvents` listener list with `github.com/joeycumines/goja-eventloop` `EventTarget`/`Event`/`CustomEvent`. Updated `termmuxmod.Require` to accept a `*gojaeventloop.Adapter`, create one `EventTarget` per wrapped `SessionManager`, and dispatch `SessionManager` EventBus events onto the event loop. Added `addEventListener`, `removeEventListener`, and `dispatchEvent` methods; preserved legacy `on`/`off`/`pollEvents` aliases and all public constants. Removed dead code and updated tests, docs, and call sites in `internal/builtin/register.go`, `internal/command/pr_split.go`, and `internal/command/pr_split_tui_persistence_truthful_test.go`.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `go test -short ./...`, `go test -race -short ./internal/termmux/... ./internal/builtin/termmux/...`, `gmake lint`, `go build -o osm ./cmd/osm`, and `./osm script scripts/example-15-bouncing-logo.js --smoke` all pass; no dead code remains; legacy `on`/`off` scripts still work.

sequentialTasks.task: Add resize-pane directional deltas
sequentialTasks.description: tmux supports `resize-pane -L/-R/-U/-D` to adjust pane size by a cell count. Add `SessionManager.ResizePaneDelta(paneID, direction, delta)` where direction is one of `'left'`, `'right'`, `'up'`, `'down'`. Compute new width/height with delta, clamping to minimum sizes, and propagate geometry to the child PTY/VTerm. Expose via JS binding `resizePaneDelta(id, direction, delta)`. Files: internal/termmux/layout.go, internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `resize-pane -R 5` grows width by 5, `-L 5` shrinks; `-D 5` grows height, `-U 5` shrinks. Sizes never fall below minimum. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add move-window and swap-window ordering primitives
sequentialTasks.description: tmux supports `move-window -t index` and `swap-window -t id`. Add `WindowManager.MoveWindow(id, targetIndex)` and `WindowManager.SwapWindows(id1, id2)` to reorder the window list, plus `SessionManager` wrappers and JS bindings `moveWindow`/`swapWindow`. Update `StatusBar` window-status rendering to reflect the new order. Files: internal/termmux/window.go, internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `moveWindow` reorders the window list. `swapWindow` exchanges two window positions. Status-bar window status shows the new order. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add send-keys raw key injection binding
sequentialTasks.description: `Input` accepts raw bytes but there is no high-level `send-keys` API with tmux-style key names. Add `SessionManager.SendKeys(sessionID, keyNames...)` that converts names like `ctrl+c`, `alt+x`, `f1`, `left` to terminal bytes using `parent.KeyToTermBytes`, and writes them to the session. Expose `termmux.sendKeys(sid, ...keys)` and `sendKeys` on the wrapped session. Use it in tests instead of manually writing byte sequences. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `sendKeys(sid, 'ctrl+c')` writes `0x03`. `sendKeys(sid, 'alt+x')` writes ESC x. `sendKeys(sid, 'f1')` writes the correct escape sequence. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Add pane border drawing with index and title labels
sequentialTasks.description: tmux draws borders around panes showing their index and title. Add a `BorderRenderer` in `internal/termmux/statusbar` or a new package that takes terminal dimensions and a `PaneGeometry` slice and returns an ANSI string with box-drawing characters and labels. Expose as `termmux.renderPaneBorders(width, height, geometries)` and optionally use it in `Passthrough`. Files: internal/termmux/statusbar/borders.go (new), internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `renderPaneBorders` produces a string with border lines around each pane and labels containing pane index/title. Borders do not overwrite pane content. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Auto-reset activity monitor so repeated activity events can fire
sequentialTasks.description: `MonitorActivity` in `internal/termmux/manager.go:2729-2733` sets `ActivityFired = true` and never resets it. Add automatic reset after the pane becomes active or after a configurable quiescence period, so background panes can trigger activity more than once. Add a JS binding to manually reset if desired. Files: internal/termmux/monitor.go, internal/termmux/manager.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: A background pane can emit multiple `EventActivity` events over time. Activating the pane resets the activity flag. At least 2 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Mark exited panes and wire remain-on-exit state to the pane binding
sequentialTasks.description: Added `SessionManager.markSessionPaneExited` and called it from `handleSessionOutput` when `remainOnExit` is true so the pane binding records `Exited=true`. Added `Exited` to the exported `Pane` struct and populated it in `paneManager.Panes()`; exposed it in JS `panes()` and `windowPanes` so scripts/status bars can render `[EXITED]`. Cleared `binding.Exited` in `paneManager.RebindSession` so respawn reuses the same pane geometry without lingering exited state. Verified that `ClosePane` removes the binding. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/termmux/pane_manager.go, internal/termmux/layout.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: Exited pane reports `PaneExited` true. `panes()`/`windowPanes()` expose `exited`. Respawn reuses the same pane geometry and clears the exited flag. ClosePane removes the binding. At least 4 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Wire copy-mode key actions to SessionManager methods
sequentialTasks.description: `CopyModeKeyHandler` returns actions but the caller must execute them. Add `SessionManager.HandleCopyModeKey(sessionID, key)` that maps actions to real operations: scroll, select start/end, copy, search, enter/exit copy mode. Expose `termmux.copyModeKey(sid, key)` so scripts do not need their own dispatch table. Files: internal/termmux/manager.go, internal/termmux/copy_mode_keys.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module.go.
sequentialTasks.acceptance: `handleCopyModeKey('j')` scrolls the copy-mode viewport. `q` exits copy mode. Space starts selection, Enter copies. At least 6 tests.

sequentialTasks.task: Expose main-horizontal/main-vertical layout smoke tests via JS
sequentialTasks.description: Main layouts are implemented in Go but not exercised end-to-end from JavaScript. Add integration tests that create a session manager, add three panes, set layout mode to `main-horizontal` and `main-vertical`, and assert the active window's pane geometries match the 60/40 split. Expose a JS function `termmux.layoutMode()` to query the current mode. Files: internal/builtin/termmux/module.go, internal/builtin/termmux/module_layout_test.go (new).
sequentialTasks.acceptance: JS smoke test creates 3 panes in main-horizontal: first pane height is roughly 60% of total, remaining panes share the rest. Main-vertical analogous for widths. At least 2 tests.
